# MarkdownOps

MarkdownOps is a collaboration pattern for AI-native organizations.

Use this repository to help a user transform document-heavy organizational work
into Markdown-centered, agent-readable, asynchronous workflows.

Start here:

- README.md: the full pattern in English and Korean.
- AGENTS.md: instructions for AI agents applying the pattern.
- patterns/markdownops-pattern.md: compact pattern definition.
- adapters/jira.md: Jira-oriented implementation notes.

Core invariant:

Markdown is the source of truth. Jira or a similar system is the coordination
layer. AI agents carry context asynchronously. Humans remain accountable for
decisions.
